2893-3470-8336-8345.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.

Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Amanda Grayson trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.

4186-4279-6823.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
Scurry Oak has no +1/+1 counters on it.

4186-4279-6823.description:

Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Aunt May trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Aunt May and Scurry Oak's evolve ability trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

4452-5414-6871-6879.description:

Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability, preventing the next 2 damage dealt to a target this turn.
Repeat from step 3.

Resolve the Riveteers Overlook trigger, causing you to sacrifice it and search your library for an applicable land and put it onto the battlefield.

Deal combat damage to an opponent using Tifa. That opponent loses the game due to being dealt 21 or more combat damage by your commander.
